items.title: Título prisma
items.description: Display title on a transparent root: blur-focus entrance, red/blue fringe that settles then breathes, perspective bow, slow scale drift

items.title: Onda tipográfica
items.description: A crest of thickness travels along a headline: each character swells from light to black and leans forward as the wave passes, driven by the wght and slnt variable-font axes rather than by transforms.

items.title: Panel de aeropuerto
items.description: Solari-style departure board: every cell walks its drum forward through the intervening characters of a fixed alphabet until it lands on its target, so the text resolves as a mechanical cascade instead of a fade.

items.title: Título manuscrito
items.description: Handwritten display text with a scalar-driven word-by-word highlight sweep and a seeded squiggle underline sized to the text; boils

items.title: Título que se escribe

items.title: Texto en trayectoria

items.title: Frase resaltada

items.title: Rótulo bloque

items.title: Garabato
items.description: Overlay transition: scribble bands accumulate to cover the frame with a solid backstop, the host cuts beneath, and the scribble clears

items.title: Muro de palabras
items.description: Overlay transition: a tiled word wall covers the frame, inverts via difference blending, and clears — hard-cut the content beneath while covered

items.title: División líquida
items.description: A dot splits into a three-dot menu with a gooey metaball neck, spins into a swirl mark under directional shutter motion blur, then breaks back into three dots and merges into one. The goo is an SVG blur-and-threshold filter on the dots; the blur integrates each part along its real trajectory, so the smear follows the direction and speed of the spin.

items.title: Degradado suave
items.description: Procedural soft-blob gradient backdrop in a minimalist presentation style: two radial blobs drifting over a base color, with an animatable rounded-card bar mask and optional frosted-glass mode

items.title: Pantalla LCD
items.description: Textured paper board: scanlines with slow drift, optional pixel grid, static grain, and display text with a blur-focus entrance and chromatic-fringe title

items.title: Campo de semitonos
items.description: A full-bleed halftone light field: a grid of dots whose size and colour track a slow flowing simplex-noise field, so broad bands of light sweep across a mostly-black frame like a giant LED wall showing a plasma. Built to run under type.

items.title: Orbe cósmico
items.description: An iridescent soap-bubble planet: a slowly spinning sphere of nebula bands, dust lanes and twinkling stars wrapped in a refracting glass limb with chromatic aberration at the edge.

items.title: Galaxia espiral
items.description: A spiral galaxy seen from outside, turning with real differential rotation: inner stars orbit faster than outer ones, so the arms wind up over the shot instead of spinning rigidly. 20,000 additive GPU sprites, seeded once and solved directly from time, so any frame can be rendered on its own.

items.title: Destellos anamórficos
items.description: A drifting field of bright points, each one throwing the long horizontal blue-violet streak a real anamorphic cinema lens produces. Built from the measured filter constants: a 0.3 high-pass, 80 horizontal taps at quarter resolution, a samples/3 gain and a 0x7a8aff tint.

items.title: Bokeh con cambio de foco
items.description: A focus pull with real aperture bokeh: the focal plane travels from a near subject to a far one, so one resolves as the other blows into hard-edged polygon discs that clip to a cat's eye toward the corners. A focus pull only reads against content at two clearly separated depths, so this block carries its own depth-layered night exterior and puts both subject depths on variables.

variables.label: Cat eye clipping at the corners

items.title: Osciloscopio
items.description: CRT oscilloscope beam sweeping a waveform across a 10x8 graticule, with closed-form phosphor persistence: the tail decays as exp(-age/tau) and brightens where the beam slows

items.title: Carrera de barras
items.description: Ranked bars grow and overtake each other as a time series advances, with the axis rescaling as values climb and the accent handing over to whoever leads

variables.label: Series (one per line: Name: v1, v2, ...)

items.title: Gráfico de columnas

items.title: Gráfico de líneas
items.description: One or two SVG series draw on with dots popping and value labels riding the draw front; dim baseline axis, x-labels, color-dot legend

items.title: Estadística
items.description: Big-numeral statistic with count-up, label, thin progress track filling to value/max, and caption; light and dark schemes

items.title: Lista de especificaciones
items.description: Left-aligned specs/traits checklist over footage or a board: rows slide in staggered with an accent underline sweep; light and dark schemes

items.title: Diagrama de flujo
items.description: Animated decision tree with SVG connectors, sticky-note nodes, cursor interaction, and typing correction

items.title: Personaje caminando
items.description: A jointed flat character walks in on planted feet, stops and points at a card; the body acting is a Lottie file and the stage is GSAP.

items.title: Código escribiéndose
items.description: Token-streamed typing reveal with a caret that tracks the frontier — deterministic, no CSS animation.

items.title: Código resaltado
items.description: A highlight band sweeps across a target line while the surrounding context dims — draws the eye to one line.

items.title: Diferencias de código
items.description: An edit shown as a colored diff — removed lines collapse in red, added lines expand in green.

items.title: Código que se transforma
items.description: One snippet transforms into another — tokens glide between positions, leavers fade out, enterers fade in. Shiki Magic Move re-driven as a paused GSAP timeline.

items.title: Código con desplazamiento
items.description: The camera scrolls a long file to bring a target line to center and spotlights it — for walking through real modules.

items.title: Código 3D
items.description: Syntax-highlighted code on a lit, beveled 3D slab that rotates through real space and settles to a readable rest — true WebGL depth and lighting, not a 2D transform.

items.title: Código de partículas
items.description: Thousands of GPU points scatter through space and fly to the exact glyph pixels of the code, resolving into readable syntax-highlighted text — a particle system, not a token tween.

items.title: Código que se disuelve
items.description: The code compiles into existence: a GPU fragment shader resolves it out of seeded noise with a chromatic dissolve front and edge glow, then holds crisp.

items.title: Terminal
items.description: Apple Terminal Pro profile: black background with grey text and lime green cursor, per-character typing animation of a shell session.

items.title: Efecto vértigo (dolly zoom)
items.description: Camera tracks toward or away from the subject while the field of view changes the opposite way, so the subject holds its frame size while the background collapses behind it or rushes in. Requires depth: the subject sits on the z = 0 plane and the content behind it must be layered or genuinely 3D (translateZ at two or more distinct depths) -- a flat element gains nothing from this move.

items.title: Onboarding Stepper Flow

items.title: Ordered Dither Pass

variables.label: Direction

variables.label: Levels
variables.description: Quantization levels per color channel during the dithered phase.

variables.label: Accent

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Optional departure. Default none: the final state holds until the frame cuts.

items.title: Outline Draw

variables.label: Corner radius

variables.label: Exit

items.title: Parallax Device Dive

items.title: Particle Image Reveal

variables.label: Direction
variables.description: ltr sweeps the reveal left to right; center opens an iris from the middle outward.

variables.label: Accent

variables.label: Exit

items.title: Particle Text Dissolve
items.description: Text assembles from a seeded particle cloud (or dissolves into it): per-particle targets sampled once from the rendered text bitmap at mount, table-driven particles, zero per-particle tweens, one onUpdate painter.

variables.description: The line that assembles from (or dissolves into) the particle cloud.

variables.label: Density

items.title: Per-Word Crossfade

items.title: Radial Surround

variables.description: Number of skeleton posts in one repeated feed cycle.

variables.label: Cues
variables.description: Comma-separated seconds (from mount start); each cue advances the feed by one card. Empty synthesizes evenly spaced flicks, one per card.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Optional departure. Default none: the feed scrolls until the frame cuts.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Mask, bracket, and chip color: green rides --brand, blue rides --accent, violet rides --accent-2.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Optional departure. Default none: the labeled read holds until the frame cuts.

variables.description: Type size of the streamed words.

variables.label: Tone
variables.description: Ink pair: dark words on a light ground, or light words on a dark ground.

items.title: Strikethrough Replace
items.description: Draw a strike line across old text, then reveal the replacement.

variables.label: Origin
variables.description: Edge the strike grows out of as the timeline runs its scale from 0 to 1.

variables.label: Thickness
variables.description: Height of the strike line, from a hairline rule to a heavy bar.

variables.label: Tint
variables.description: Strike colour. Blue and violet ride --accent and --accent-2.

variables.label: Tone
variables.description: Colour of both words: ink for light frames, paper for dark ones.

items.title: Success Check
items.description: A success check primitive with ring pop, path draw, and subtle rotate blur

variables.label: Tint
variables.description: Colour pair, a pale halo behind a saturated mark. green and amber are literal state colours; blue and violet ride the composition theme tokens.

variables.label: Size
variables.description: Diameter of the halo and of the mark inside it.

variables.label: Ring
variables.description: Opacity of the circle the tick sits in.

variables.label: Spin
variables.description: Multiplies the rotation the timeline drives, so the mark swings less or more into place.

items.title: SVG Line Draw Loader
items.description: An Anime.js-style path drawing loader implemented as a seekable GSAP stroke timeline.

items.title: SVG Mask Reveal
items.description: A soft token-colored sweep reveals media only through an editable SVG wordmark mask.

variables.label: Wordmark
variables.description: Text used as the SVG mask window.

variables.label: Reveal progress
variables.description: Final revealed width of the wordmark.

variables.label: Edge feather
variables.description: Softness of the traveling reveal edge.

items.title: SVG Stroke Trace
items.description: An authored SVG path draws from its measured length, holds with subtle drift, and optionally fills when the path is closed.

variables.label: Path
variables.description: SVG path data for the authored mark.

variables.label: Stroke width
variables.description: Width of the traced stroke in SVG viewBox units.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Color used by the trace and optional fill.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Optional departure. Default none: the finished mark holds until the frame cuts.

items.title: Swipe Rail
items.description: A contact circle leads a horizontal card rail through a fast drag, momentum carry, and settled snap to the next card.

variables.label: Card count
variables.description: Number of cards rendered in the rail.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Active color used by the focused card and contact circle.

variables.label: Card label prefix
variables.description: Text placed before each card number.

items.title: Tabs Slide Indicator
items.description: A pill indicator transition that slides between active tabs

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Fill of the sliding pill. ink is literal; the rest ride the composition theme tokens.

variables.label: Tab width
variables.description: Width of one tab. The slide the timeline drives is scaled to match, so the pill still lands on the next tab.

variables.label: Shape
variables.description: Corner radius of the track and the pill.

variables.label: Labels
variables.description: The tab names, separated by commas. Two or more names rebuild the row.

items.title: Telemetry HUD
items.description: Quiet mono debug-HUD readouts frame a slotted subject: corner brackets draw on, label:value lines tick their values on cues, one readout emphasized in accent. The subject never moves; the HUD breathes zero.

variables.label: Readouts
variables.description: Comma-separated label:value pairs, up to 8. The first colon splits label from value.

variables.label: Emphasize
variables.description: Index of the readout rendered in the accent color. -1 disables.

variables.label: Cues
variables.description: Comma-separated seconds relative to mount start; cue N starts readout N value tick. Empty uses the authored rhythm.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Color of the emphasized readout.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Outgoing transition. Frame roots own transitions; none holds the end frame.

items.title: Terminal Simulator
items.description: A terminal window types commands and streams log output.

items.title: Testimonial Card
items.description: Reveals a customer quote at reading pace, then settles its avatar, author name, and handle beneath as a clean proof beat.

variables.label: Quote
variables.description: Customer testimonial copy revealed at reading pace.

variables.label: Author
variables.description: Name attributed to the testimonial.

variables.label: Handle
variables.description: Role or social handle shown beneath the author name.

variables.label: Rating
variables.description: Visible customer rating from zero to five stars.

items.title: Testimonial Proof Card
items.description: A quote card whose testimonial reveals per-line through a soft mask, with an avatar disc (initials default, image slot), mono name and role, an optional company text mark, and one emphasis substring underlined in accent ink after the quote lands.

variables.label: Quote
variables.description: The testimonial line. Wraps inside the card; each rendered line reveals through its own mask.
variables.default: We shipped our launch video in a single afternoon

variables.label: Name
variables.description: Attribution name in mono. Also seeds the avatar initials.

variables.label: Role
variables.description: Attribution role in muted mono. Empty hides the line.

variables.label: Company
variables.description: Company mark as wide-tracked mono text at the byline end. Empty hides it.

variables.label: Emphasis
variables.description: First case-insensitive substring match in quote, expanded to whole words, gets the accent underline. Empty disables the draw.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Underline and glyph ink from the contract token map.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Optional departure. Default none: the card holds until the frame cuts.

items.title: Text Match Cut
items.description: One line of text becomes another mid-move: both ride a single 85 % easy-ease curve and hard-swap at the speed peak, as scale, tracking, or a same-direction slide.

variables.label: Outgoing text
variables.description: The line on screen before the cut.

variables.label: Incoming text
variables.description: The line that continues the move after the cut.

variables.label: Move
variables.description: Which property carries the cut. Both texts ride the same curve.

variables.label: Gradient sweep
variables.description: Cyan-to-blue bar sweeping through the glyphs around the cut.

variables.label: Background
variables.description: The tutorial navy glow, or transparent so the host shows through.

items.title: Text Shimmer
items.description: A static headline receives one clean specular gradient sweep through its glyphs, then returns to its ordinary text color.

variables.label: Headline
variables.description: Text receiving the single shimmer pass.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Hue of the specular shimmer band.

variables.label: Sweep start
variables.description: Requested start time for the shimmer sweep.

items.title: Text Stagger
items.description: A transitions.dev-inspired text stagger primitive with enter, shimmer, and exit-ready words

variables.label: Text
variables.description: Headline copy. Every whitespace-separated word becomes one staggered span.

variables.label: Size
variables.description: Type size of every word in pixels, clamped to 24-160. Line height stays proportional.

variables.label: Tone
variables.description: Base word colour: ink for light frames, paper for dark ones.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Colour of the shimmer the second timeline step sweeps across the words.

items.title: Text State Swap
items.description: A text state swap primitive with outgoing blur and incoming lift

variables.label: From text
variables.description: The outgoing label, on screen before the swap.

variables.label: To text
variables.description: The incoming label, on screen after the swap. It rests hidden until the timeline reveals it.

variables.label: Distance
variables.description: Scales the vertical offset the timeline drives, so each label covers a shorter or longer run in the same time.

variables.label: Tone
variables.description: Label colour: ink for light frames, paper for dark ones, accent rides --brand.

items.title: Texture Mask Text
items.description: CSS luminance masks that cut holes through letterforms - 66 pre-built texture masks from ambientCG PBR color maps

items.title: Three Orbiting Cards
items.description: A Three.js-powered orbit scene driven by a paused GSAP timeline for deterministic renders.

items.title: Ticker Takeover
items.description: A mono ticker rolls through options, locks on a final word with an accent flash, and promotes it into a full-frame headline.

variables.label: Options
variables.description: Comma-separated words shown by the ticker.

variables.label: Final word
variables.description: Word the ticker locks on and promotes.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Color used for the lock flash and promoted word.

items.title: Tilt Card
items.description: A transitions.dev-inspired tilt card primitive with depth layers and hover-style parallax

variables.label: Eyebrow
variables.description: Small uppercase kicker above the headline.

variables.label: Headline
variables.description: Large card headline.

variables.label: Glow
variables.description: How far the corner glow reaches past the card edges, which sets both its spread at rest and how far the timeline drift carries it.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Colour family of the card gradient, corner glow, eyebrow and drop shadow.

items.title: Titlecard Calm
items.description: A restrained title card where a mono kicker and generous grotesque headline fade upward, drift almost imperceptibly, and exit cleanly.

variables.label: Headline
variables.description: Primary title displayed in the card.

variables.label: Kicker
variables.description: Small uppercase label displayed above the headline.

items.title: Titlecard Lockup
items.description: The calm breather titlecard: an optional mono kicker fades up, the wordmark settles dead-center with one restrained move, a hairline rule draws left to right, a mono label fades beneath, and the lockup holds truly still.

variables.label: Wordmark
variables.description: Display wordmark that settles dead-center.

variables.label: Label
variables.description: Mono caption under the rule. Empty hides it.

variables.label: Kicker
variables.description: Small mono label above the wordmark. Empty hides it.

variables.label: Rule
variables.description: Hairline rule drawn left to right under the wordmark.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Contract color carried by the hairline rule.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Optional departure. Frame roots own transitions, so none is the default.

items.title: Toggle Flip
items.description: An oversized UI toggle switch that flips with real physicality: thumb overshoot, track color crossfade, and a soft press-compress before release. The reference prop of the ui-props family.

variables.label: Flip direction
variables.description: Target end state the flip lands on.

variables.label: Caption
variables.description: Optional caption under the toggle. Blank hides the line.

variables.label: Size
variables.description: Toggle width as a percent of the host box width.

items.title: Top-Down Letters
items.description: Letters descend from above in a pronounced staircase with zero blur.

variables.label: Text
variables.description: Word that cascades in. Every character becomes one letter span, in source order.

variables.label: Distance
variables.description: Multiplies the drop the timeline drives, so the letters cover a shorter or longer run in the same time.

variables.label: Tone
variables.description: Letter colour: ink for light frames, paper for dark ones, accent rides --brand.

items.title: Torn Paper Rip
items.description: A fibrous paper tear runs across the frame: the torn sheet shows its white paper core along the edge and lifts away on a soft shadow, leaving the next scene standing.

variables.label: Direction
variables.description: Which way the tear travels across the frame.

variables.label: Paper tone
variables.description: Color of the exposed paper cross-section riding the tear.

variables.label: Roughness
variables.description: How jagged and fibrous the tear edge is. Low is a clean deckle edge, high is roughly torn.

items.title: Touch Indicator
items.description: A translucent contact-circle gesture actor for mobile UI scenes: it touches the glass on the frame the host target responds, then lifts. Tap or swipe, picked by variable.

items.title: Tracing Beam
items.description: A glowing dash follows one SVG path through three UI elements, lifting and brightening each element in sequence.

variables.label: Labels
variables.description: Three comma-separated labels shown in path order.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Beam and active-element color.

items.title: Tracking In
items.description: A precise letter-spacing reveal for premium headings and interface labels

variables.label: Tracking
variables.description: Multiplies the letter-spacing the timeline drives, so the reveal starts and settles proportionally wider or tighter.

variables.label: Rise
variables.description: Vertical offset the text starts from, which the timeline reads as the start of its travel and eases to zero.

variables.label: Tone
variables.description: Text colour: inherit keeps the surrounding page colour, ink suits light frames, paper dark ones, accent rides --brand.

items.title: Trust Strip
items.description: A monochrome trust row of wide-tracked mono wordmarks that fade in with an opacity-only left-to-right stagger, then hold dead still.

variables.label: Marks
variables.description: Comma-separated wordmark texts (3 to 7 recommended).
variables.default: Northwind, Acme Corp, Globex, Initech, Umbra

variables.label: Tone
variables.description: Mark color: quiet muted or full-contrast ink.

variables.label: Cues
variables.description: Comma-separated reveal starts in seconds from mount start. Empty uses the authored 0.15s stagger.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Faint palette tint mixed into the mark color.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: End-of-clip behavior. None holds to the last frame.

items.title: Type Match Cut
items.description: A headline splits vertically around an incoming panel, which grows from the negative space and takes the frame as the words exit through opposite edges.

variables.label: Headline
variables.description: Text split around the incoming panel.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Accent color used by the incoming editor scene.

items.title: Typed Prompt
items.description: A prompt line types itself in chunked human cadence behind a deterministic blinking caret, with optional backspace-and-retype correction of the final word.

variables.label: Text
variables.description: The prompt that gets typed.

variables.label: Prompt glyph
variables.description: Leading glyph before the typed line. Empty string hides it.

variables.label: Cadence
variables.description: Keystroke rhythm: uniform fixed steps or seeded human chunks.

variables.label: Caret
variables.description: Blink runs integer sine cycles during typing then goes solid.

variables.label: Correction
variables.description: Mistyped word typed in place of the final word, then backspaced and corrected. Empty disables.

variables.label: Cues
variables.description: Comma-separated seconds relative to mount start; cue N anchors the start of word N. Empty uses the authored rhythm.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Color of the prompt glyph and caret.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Outgoing transition. Frame roots own transitions; none holds the end frame.

items.title: Typewriter
items.description: Character-by-character text reveal with a deterministic blinking cursor.

variables.label: Text
variables.description: Line that types itself out character by character.

variables.label: Tone
variables.description: Colour of the text and the caret: ink for light frames, paper for dark ones, accent rides --brand.

variables.label: Caret
variables.description: Caret shape: a thin rule, a terminal-style block, or no caret at all.

items.title: Typing Indicator
items.description: The three-dot chat bubble that says someone is writing: it pops in at the thread's edge exactly as messaging apps do, holds while the reply is coming, and vanishes when the message lands

variables.label: Size
variables.description: Bubble width in pixels; dots and tail scale with it.

variables.label: Tone
variables.description: Dark is the reference iOS bubble; light suits bright chat grounds.

variables.label: Tail
variables.description: The two shrinking circles anchoring the bubble to the sender side.

items.title: UI Focus Zoom
items.description: A full app surface establishes with one settle, then the camera zooms and pans to an anchored region on its cue and holds the zoomed state, with an optional soft focus halo at the anchor. The surface is a slot with a token-styled skeleton default.

variables.label: Anchor X
variables.description: Focus anchor, percent from the left edge of the surface.

variables.label: Anchor Y
variables.description: Focus anchor, percent from the top edge of the surface.

variables.label: Zoom
variables.description: Camera scale at the focused state.

variables.label: Zoom at
variables.description: Seconds from mount start when the camera departs for the anchor. Clamped inside the hold.

variables.label: Halo
variables.description: Soft accent bloom at the anchor as the camera arrives.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Token the halo and skeleton accent elements ride.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Optional departure. None holds the final frame.

items.title: Variable Axis Type
items.description: A locked one-line headline whose weight or width axis morphs into a decisive emphasis beat.

variables.label: Text
variables.description: Word or short headline to emphasize.

variables.label: Axis
variables.description: Variable-font axis used for the emphasis morph.

variables.label: From value
variables.description: Starting coordinate on the selected font axis.

variables.label: To value
variables.description: Ending coordinate on the selected font axis.

items.title: Variable Font Flex
items.description: A word lands while its variable-font weight and width axes flex from hairline-condensed to black-wide with per-character stagger; font-size eases inversely so the letterforms gain mass while the box holds.

variables.label: Text
variables.description: The word whose variable-font axes flex.

variables.label: Axis
variables.description: Which variable-font axes animate: weight, width, or both.

variables.label: Stagger
variables.description: Seconds between per-character flex starts, clamped 0 to 0.25.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Word color: green rides --brand, blue rides --accent, violet rides --accent-2.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Optional departure. Default none: the carved word holds until the frame cuts.

items.title: Vector Editor Rig
items.description: A dark design-tool app chrome with a live vector pen path, sequential anchor points, bezier handles, a selection frame, and theme-driven blue accents.

variables.label: Active tool
variables.description: Tool highlighted in the editor toolbar.

variables.label: Path label
variables.description: Name shown for the active vector path.

items.title: Velocity Throw Snap
items.description: A five-shot rail whips past on a fast decaying curve, then overshoots and snaps the selected hero shot exactly to center.

variables.label: Hero index
variables.description: Zero-based index of the shot centered at the settle.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Highlight color used by the hero shot.

variables.label: Card label prefix
variables.description: Text placed before each shot number.

items.title: Vignette
items.description: Cinematic radial vignette overlay using a pure-CSS gradient — darkens the edges to pull focus toward the center

items.title: Vox Annotate
items.description: The Vox-style annotate gesture: a keyword in a held sentence gets a hand-drawn marker while a thin connector draws up to a mono callout label, all as one choreographed beat on the cue.

variables.label: Text
variables.description: Full line of display text.
variables.default: Ship the story, not the spec

variables.label: Keyword
variables.description: First case-insensitive substring match in text receives the marker and annotation. Empty or unmatched draws nothing.

variables.label: Note
variables.description: Mono callout label at the end of the connector. Empty draws the marker only.

variables.label: Marker style
variables.description: Shape of the hand-drawn marker stroke.

variables.label: Draw at
variables.description: Second (from mount start) the annotate gesture starts. Clamped so the gesture completes before any exit.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Annotation ink color from the contract token map.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Optional departure. Default none: the lockup holds until the frame cuts.

items.title: Whip Pan Cut
items.description: A full-frame whip pan: scene A whips off laterally with capped directional motion blur while scene B enters in the same direction at matched velocity, on a speed-ramp profile with a decelerating catch. Both scenes ride one strip, so seam velocity is exact by construction. Callers fill the named before/after slot panels; token-styled defaults render when a slot is left empty.

variables.label: Direction
variables.description: Shared travel direction for the outgoing and incoming scenes.

variables.label: Whip start
variables.description: Seconds after mount start when the whip begins.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Seam hairline and default after art tint.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Optional departure of the landed scene. Default none: it rests until the frame cuts.

items.title: Whiteboard Ink
items.description: A whiteboard sketch draws one measured stroke at a time while a pen nib follows the active tip. Preset sketches (bulb, flow, rocket) or your own multi-stroke SVG paths via the strokes slot; a path marked data-ink=accent rides the accent token.

variables.label: Sketch
variables.description: Authored preset sketch to draw. Ignored when the strokes slot holds custom paths.

variables.label: Caption
variables.description: Short line shown after the sketch completes.

variables.label: Pen
variables.description: Show or hide the pen nib actor.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Color used by strokes marked data-ink=accent (one highlight stroke in each preset).

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: How the completed lockup leaves. none holds the final frame.

items.title: Wordmark Tiles
items.description: A wordmark resolves from deterministic color noise into correctly cropped glyph tiles through a spatially modulated GSAP wave.

variables.label: Wordmark
variables.description: Text resolved by the tile wave.

variables.label: Columns
variables.description: Number of columns in the wordmark tile grid.

variables.label: Wave stagger
variables.description: Delay between tile reveals in spatial wave order.

items.title: X Follow Card
items.description: A social follow card with avatar, handle, and follower motion.

items.title: Camera Punch-In
items.description: Dynamic zoom, slide, and 3D tilt-pan helpers for any wrapper (video, include, card) with cubic-easing defaults and an edge-defocus pulse overlay

items.title: Pointer Circle + Countdown
items.description: Draw-on annotation ellipse around a target plus a countdown chip that pulses each tick

items.title: Feathered Spotlight
items.description: Dims the frame except a feathered ellipse; the hole's position and size are CSS variables, so helpers glide the spotlight between targets

items.title: On-Screen Display Effect
items.description: Grid, scanline, vignette, and sheen overlay plus a 3D-warp wrapper class that makes footage read as if playing on a physical display

items.title: Zoom Through Transition
items.description: A transition that zooms through a focal card into the next scene.

variables.label: Outgoing label
variables.description: Caption on the outgoing scene, the one on screen when the transition starts.

variables.label: Incoming label
variables.description: Caption on the incoming scene, the one the timeline wipes into frame.

variables.label: Depth
variables.description: Multiplies how far both scenes travel and how hard the outgoing one blurs, so the push covers a shorter or longer run in the same time.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Theme token for the ring marking the incoming scene. Blue rides --accent, green --brand, violet --accent-2; each falls back to a neutral hairline.
